title: Relaxed carriage ride in Seville
text: If you want to visit Seville in just one day, a horse-drawn carriage ride through the historic city center is definitely recommended. The price of 45 euros for three people was reasonable and you get a great overview of the sights on the ride.
author: volker59

title: The temperatures in Seville were...
text:
The temperatures in Seville were going to get to 105 degrees today, so we welcomed starting our tour at 9:00 AM. Our horse, carriage and guide awaited us at the hotel. We had a nice hour-long carriage ride through the parks around the area of the 1932 Spanish Exposition. Our guide was knowledgable and sufficiently explained what we were seeing.
